title: private/coursewerk/CLAIMS.json — claim/assertion nodes (granularity fix; additive to COMPONENT_INDEX.json)

text.description: The claim's asserted prose — the input to the `content` fingerprint. REQUIRED in practice: without it a schema-valid claim carries no content to fingerprint.

scope.description: The chapter scope this claim's terms resolve in; null = package-wide. DERIVED ONCE, BY M2, AND STORED — consumers (M3, M6, …) MUST read this field and MUST NOT re-derive it. Rationale: scope selects which term an ambiguous label resolves to, so two modules deriving it two ways (M6 from spineRefs, M3 from locations[0].file) would silently disagree about what a claim is ABOUT — the exact defect class this index exists to catch. Frozen derivation (interfaces §4): first spineRefs entry matching ^(concept|objective)\.(?<scope>[^.]+)\. wins; else locations[0].file mapped via the concept-map file convention; else null.

offset.description: Offset of this claim's text within `file`, as a JS STRING INDEX (UTF-16 code units) — the unit `lib/immutable.mjs` (M8) indexes its regions in. **NOT a byte offset.** The two diverge on any non-ASCII character (`°`, `→`, Greek letters), which a chemistry package is guaranteed to contain — the golden fixture itself says `100 °C`. This is not a pedantic distinction: a byte offset does not fail loudly, it lands one character INSIDE the quotation, which is precisely the fabrication case the check exists to prevent. (Demonstrated: for `Heat to 100 °C. Then: "the melting point..."`, M8 reports the quote at 22; the byte offset is 23; slicing at 23 lands inside the quote.) SET ONCE BY M2 at extraction; consumers READ it (§5d) and MUST NOT re-derive it by searching for the claim text — that breaks on any repeated sentence. Without it, M9's plan-time immutable-region check CANNOT RUN: M8's regions are file offsets, so a claim carrying only {file, anchor} gives planPropagation nothing to compare against. Optional ONLY because a claim may be built in memory without a file; when a real file location exists, M2 MUST set it, and a consumer MUST treat its absence as fail-closed (refuse the edit) rather than as offset 0.

anchorSlug.description: G22: the inline `[anchor: slug]` the author placed on this block, when any. Identity and the id key on `<file>|@<slug>` instead of the positional anchor, so a reorder keeps the claim. `locations[].anchor` still says where the block stands now.

provenanceDeclared.description: true = declared by the generator per contract; false = found by the deterministic scan backstop (indexed + WARN, never hard-fail)

overrideId.description: Id of the OVERRIDES.json entry authorizing this claim's divergence, if any. The `provenance` fingerprint hashes sourceRefs + this. (status:'overridden' is a flag, not an id.)
